Your fridge has a water filter. When did you last change it? 🚰

Fairfield County homeowners: on a lot of models it's down at the bottom. Pull the old one, push the new one in until it clicks, done. Check your manual for how often. Most people go years without touching it.

Send this to someone who's never changed theirs.
